# Dick Moore

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-thirties  <sub>[v4 c6 P28](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0028), [v4 c10 P50](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0050)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Four Winds (Glen St. Mary), Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v4 c6 P28](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0028), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>
- **Role:** Sailor and clerk  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

In his youth, Dick was a tall, handsome man with a high color, light hair, and an unusual physical trait: one blue eye and one hazel eye. After his departure from Four Winds, he was mistakenly believed to have grown quite stout, heavy, and broad-faced.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

Dick was a handsome man with a small, selfish soul who was accustomed to getting his own way. He was inclined to be heavy-drinking and possessed a reckless, sea-going nature. Though occasionally pleasant when things went his way, he possessed a malicious and domineering streak.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033)_

## Traits

- Handsome and dashing  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028)</sub>
- Selfish and spoiled  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- Inclined to drink  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- Reckless and stubborn  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028)</sub>

## Abilities

- Seamanship and clerking  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Goals

- Pursuing his own desires and going to sea  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028)</sub>

## History

Dick Moore grew up at Four Winds as the son of Abner Moore. As a young man, he worked in his father's store during the winter and went to sea in the summer. He became enamored with Leslie West and, through his father holding a heavy mortgage on the West farm, coercively induced her mother to force Leslie into marrying him when she was sixteen. Following their marriage, he lived with Leslie on the West farm for a winter before leaving in the spring on a voyage to Cuba aboard the ship Four Sisters. While in Cuba, Dick contracted yellow fever and died. His cousin, George Moore, stayed behind to nurse him, leaving the ship to sail without them. Shortly after Dick's death, George suffered a traumatic brain injury in a brawling accident that destroyed his memory and intellect. When Captain Jim later found the brain-damaged George in Havana, he mistook him for Dick due to their striking physical resemblance and brought him back to Four Winds, where Leslie nursed him for twelve years believing him to be her husband. The truth was finally discovered when Dr. Gilbert Blythe suggested a trephining operation, which restored George Moore's memory and revealed that the real Dick Moore had died thirteen years prior.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c29 P10](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0010), [v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_
